smallest_supported_claim: The isolated v003 run loaded the accepted R032 camp and character:25 Locker equipment, created a native CAMP_PATROL zone, and set patrol priority 9. The saved current shift plan listed character:25 as its active guard, but the native diagnostic still reported no patrol runtime/order, so this run reached no bandit outing or contact. The world was saved through native save and quit and the game exited through the native main-menu quit route with exit code 0.
causal_account: This run deliberately created the patrol zone and changed priorities after loading the stock fixture. At game minute 7633, the cached day plan was current, with roster character:25 and active_guard=true, while runtime_state=not_assigned and the actor remained CAMP_RESIDENT with camp_patrol_order=false at priority 9. The game had also performed an automatic save at minute 7634. The source code computes patrol duty windows from the cached worker priorities; a fresh next run will set job priorities before creating or querying a patrol zone, so the cache is first built from the intended priority. This observation is not yet enough to establish a product defect.
